top_signals.title: US-Backed Firm to Ink Venezuela Dredging Deal to Aid Oil Exports
top_signals.summary: The US-backed firm working to help revive Venezuela’s oil production plans to sign a dredging deal to make it easier to export from a lake in the heart of the nation’s oldest oilfields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Tech stocks see monster rally after Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq slid 10% last week in its worst week since the early days of Covid in 2020.
